source_assessment.guard: res.json() is awaited separately. Abort and captured-scope checks occur after it resolves and before contract parsing, event filtering, SeenIds mutation, cursor assignment, onChange or has_more continuation. Plain JSON parsing and these synchronous checks have no intervening await before page application.
source_assessment.revoked_propagation: The new Revoked throw at line 233 is outside both the body-read catch and parser catch. The poll caller explicitly rethrows Revoked at line 275; the fatal handler invokes onRevoked once and returns at lines 287-289. It cannot be reclassified as Transport or NeedsReset along this corrected path. Fenced contract-invalid JSON objects and reset_required pages were independently exercised and also revoke once without resets.
source_assessment.abort: Abort is checked before the scope fence; the polling catch/fatal paths return without publication or revocation. Independent abort-only and simultaneous abort-plus-fence probes both terminate quietly.
source_assessment.unchanged_scope: The independent positive control processes two pages, advances the next request from c0 to c1, suppresses replayed event one, delivers new event two, filters a foreign-conversation event, and reports polling once. No revocation or reset occurs.
source_assessment.security_scan: The complete added-line delta was inspected: no secrets, new external endpoints, executable-input sinks, persistence changes or authority expansion. Only the missing polling application boundary and its regression file change.

regression_quality.actual_modules: poll-scope.test.ts imports actual subscribeWork and scopedFetch. setup-scope.ts invokes bindTestScope, which binds via actual probeSession rather than mocking the scope guards. The delayed ReadableStream uses highWaterMark 0, so bodyStarted signals actual body consumption after successful headers, not eager prefetch.
regression_quality.assertion_strength: The two fenced cases assert zero changes, no polling status, exactly one revocation, zero resets, and no added subscribeWork fetch attempts for has_more false and true. Counting above scopedFetch detects locally refused extra attempts, which raw transport counts alone would miss. Abort is separately tested. A bounded sleep loop makes faulty behavior terminate rather than hang.
